snapshot.calendar_date_status: Only clock time is supplied; assigned collection date, not independently verified by snapshot endpoint.
snapshot.universe: Sina current mainland A-share provider list
snapshot.historical_universe_limitation: Current-list retrospective sample; delisted securities absent.

shareholder_quality.time_basis: announcement date, not effective interval date
shareholder_quality.limitation: Not merged with executives. Cumulative/overlapping disclosure intervals may remain; these are ratio candidates, not an audited net-flow series.

assumptions.P20/P60: percentage of eligible prices above MA20/MA60; hypothesis only
assumptions.MCL: 19/39 EMA differences of net advances, plus ratio-adjusted variant; hypothesis only; EMA seeded with first observation
assumptions.equity_bond_spread: 100 / provider PE - 10y yield in percent; PE response is sparse/monthly; 12 matched observations rolling ±2 sigma; hypothesis only, 252-day bands unavailable
assumptions.weekly_bar: Last observed trading session, final group may be incomplete if collected midweek
assumptions.returns: Tencent qfq close changes, not original unrounded daily return flags
